transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... things have just been really intense lately. I went from barely settling into my new apartment to suddenly taking on way too much. I started saying yes to all these mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes, and I even decided to redesign my whole portfolio. It was like... I just felt like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint. And I guess I realized I needed to talk to someone about it.
During this intense period, did you find that you needed less sleep than usual to feel rested?

Yeah, actually. Um, for several nights there, I think I slept maybe three or four hours. But I'd wake up and... I was convinced I was totally fine. I didn't feel exhausted at all. I just figured I should use the extra time in the early morning to get ahead on all those projects I'd taken on.
Before this recent period, have you ever had a time in your life when you felt deeply down, depressed, or lost interest in things for several weeks?

Yeah, I have. Um... before that whole intense sprint started, I was actually feeling really down. I would wake up with this... this heavy, gray feeling in my chest. And it didn't really make sense because the apartment would be totally quiet, nothing bad was happening, but I'd feel so low that I felt like I could just break down and cry over a coffee mug left in the sink. It was just a really overwhelming sadness.
Did this intense surge of energy and activity cause significant problems or disruptions at work or in your relationships?

Yeah, it did. Um... at work, I actually ended up missing an important design review because I was just doing too many things at once and lost track of time. And as for my relationships... I've honestly just been avoiding my friends and family lately. I feel really embarrassed about how scattered and, I guess, unreliable I've seemed to everyone.
About how long did this period of intense energy and reduced sleep last?
Well, this whole intense pattern—you know, the up and down—it's been going on since I moved into my new apartment. So, that's been about a month now.

Did that intense period ever get severe enough that you needed to be admitted to the hospital?
No, it didn't. Um, I've never been in the hospital for this. It was definitely overwhelming and a lot to deal with, but... no, I didn't need to be admitted or anything like that.
During that time, were you still able to continue doing your job, or did it completely stop you from being able to work?

Well, I didn't completely stop working, but it definitely affected my job. I actually missed a major design review because I was just so scattered. And... I guess it's affecting my personal life too. I've been avoiding my friends and family lately because I just feel really embarrassed about how unreliable and all over the place I've been.
